items.title: Jacoby Brissett: Pads stats late in loss
items.description:
Brissett completed 29 of 47 passes for 292 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding two rushes for 19 yards and a seven-yard reception on his only target in the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Courtland Sutton: Reaches end zone in Week 5
items.description:
Sutton posted two catches (on three targets) for 18 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 23-17 victory at the Chargers.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jared Goff: Four total TDs in win
items.description:
Goff completed 19 of 30 passes for 271 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while adding a one-yard touchdown on his only rush attempt in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday. He also committed a fumble recovered by Detroit.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Wilson: Limited by Lions in loss
items.description:
Wilson brought in four of seven targets for 30 yards and completed his only pass attempt for seven yards in the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Punches in TD in win over Vegas
items.description:
Stevenson carried the ball 13 times for 64 yards and a touchdown and caught all three of his targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 45-17 rout of the Raiders.
